name: DALL·E 3
description: State-of-the-art image generation from text prompts.
longDescription: DALL·E 3 is OpenAI's latest image generation model that understands significantly more nuance and detail compared to previous systems. It can generate images from text descriptions with remarkable accuracy, following complex prompts and producing high-quality visuals.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI()
response = client.images.generate(
    model="dall-e-3",
    prompt="A futuristic cityscape at sunset",
    size="1024x1024"
)
print(response.data[0].url)

codeSnippets.label: JavaScript
cURL
codeSnippets.code:
curl https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"dall-e-3","prompt":"A futuristic cityscape at sunset","size":"1024x1024"}'
